Name: Orca Deck
Author: Jérémie Paret
Description: One key per Orca worktree with live agent status. Press to focus, hold to replace with a fresh worktree, + to start a new one. Neo infobar shows token usage and worktree details.

Actions.Name: Worktree
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the Orca worktree assigned to this key. Press: focus. Hold: replace with a new worktree. Empty (+): new worktree.

Actions.Name: Orca Infobar
Actions.Tooltip: Stream Deck Neo infobar: worktree counters, token usage, details of the last pressed worktree.
